name: Townhouse Oak Legian Near Legian Beach Formerly Sayang Maha Merta
detail: I am grateful every day for this service and quality for just under 2000 yen per night. The only inconvenience is that there is no refrigerator, but other than that, there is nothing inconvenient at all. The front desk staff and everyone else are all very pleasant and wonderful people, allowing me to have a happy time. Thank you very much.

name: Palette Signature Hotel
detail: Although it's older than the images, the minimum conditions for staying are met. I was concerned about the lack of facilities and the smell of sewage. However, the room was spacious, there was a pool, it was close to the bus stop, and above all, the smiles of the staff were wonderful.

name: Palette Resort Near Muaya Beach Jimbaran
detail: 전반적으로 서비스가 정말 별로였어요. 수영장에서 사용할 비치타월을 요청했는데, 따로 비치타월은 없고 방에 있는 욕실 타월을 가져가서 쓰라고 하더라고요...ㅋㅋ 그래서 다음 날 수건을 새로 달라고 했더니 이번에는 아직 빨래가 안 끝나서 수건을 줄 수 없다고 했어요. 호텔에서 수건조차 바로 제공이 안 된다는 게 좀 황당했습니다. 다음 날 다시 비치타월을 요청했는데 매니저가 또 방에 있는 수건을 가져가서 쓰라면서 “잃어버리지 말라”고 하더라고요ㅋㅋ 아니... 누가 잃어버리려고 수건을 빌리나요? 😂 말하는 방식도 그렇고, 전반적으로 매니저가 별로 도움이 된다는 느낌을 받지 못했어요. 청소도 크게 기대하지 않았습니다. 가성비 호텔인 걸 감안해서 그냥 숙박하는 동안 하루만 청소해 달라고 요청하고 말았어요. 그리고 호텔로 들어가는 길이 정말 심하게 울퉁불퉁합니다. 오토바이 타고 들어갈 때마다 허리 다 나갈 것 같은 수준이었어요. 오토바이로 이동하실 분들은 참고하시는 게 좋을 것 같아요. 제일 황당했던 건 마지막 날이었습니다. 밤 비행기라 체크아웃 후 돌아다니기 싫어서 일부러 하루를 추가로 결제해서 편하게 쉬다가 공항에 가려고 했는데, 갑자기 전기가 다 나갔어요. 샤워도 못 하고, 방이 너무 어두워서 핸드폰 플래시를 켜고 겨우 짐을 쌌습니다.그런데 이런 상황에 대해 호텔에서 미리 아무런 안내도 없었어요. 저도 여행하면서 가성비 호텔 정말 많이 이용해봤고, 가격이 저렴한 만큼 시설이나 서비스에 큰 기대를 하는 편도 아닙니다. 하지만 이렇게 기본적인 서비스가 부족하고, 문제가 생겼을 때 직원이나 매니저가 별 도움이 되지 않았던 곳은 처음입니다. 가격이 저렴하다는 점을 감안하더라도 개인적으로는 다시 이용하고 싶지 않습니다. Overall, the service at this hotel was very disappointing. I asked for a beach towel to use at the pool, but I was told to just take the bath towel from my room instead. The next day, when I asked for fresh towels, I was told they couldn’t give me any because the laundry wasn’t finished yet. I honestly found it quite strange that a hotel couldn’t even provide fresh towels when requested. I asked for a beach towel again the following day, and the manager once again told me to use the towel from my room and then told me “don’t lose it.” 😂 I mean... who borrows a hotel towel with the intention of losing it? The way it was communicated was unnecessary, and overall, I didn’t find the manager particularly helpful. I also didn’t expect much from the housekeeping because I understood that this was a budget hotel. I simply asked them to clean our room once during our stay and left it at that. Another thing to be aware of is the road leading into the hotel. It is extremely rough and bumpy, especially if you are travelling by scooter. Every time we rode in, it honestly felt like my back was going to break. The most frustrating experience happened on our last day. We had a late-night flight, so we actually paid for an extra night just so we could relax, shower, pack comfortably and leave for the airport later that evening. However, the electricity went out. We couldn’t even shower, and the room was so dark that we had to pack our luggage using the flashlights on our phones. What made it worse was that the hotel gave us no advance notice at all. I’ve stayed at many budget hotels while travelling, so I don’t expect luxury service when I’m paying a lower price. However, this was the first time I experienced such poor basic service and staff who were so unhelpful when issues came up. Even considering the affordable price, I personally wouldn’t stay here again.

name: Amnaya Resort Kuta
detail: The first hotel I arrived at in Bali may be hard to surpass later on. The cost-performance ratio is incredibly high; the hotel's restaurant breakfast is worth half the room rate, very plentiful, and coffee can be refilled with a wide variety of choices. I stayed for three days, and the breakfast in the picture was the best option. I also experienced a lunch with a special Indonesian set for two; the signage and service explanations were very satisfactory, and I got to taste many different kinds of sauces. The spa, although the pressure was a bit gentle, had the best environment, service attitude, and quality of essential oils. Plus, it's just a three-minute walk to Discovery Mall, which is great for shopping needs immediately after arriving or just before leaving. The Nasty restaurant and Korean cuisine in the mall were also of higher quality than roadside eateries. The hotel's cleanliness is excellent with very few insects, and the internet is good as well. My favorite part is the small balcony in the room; it’s very comfortable to lounge there. The pool may not look luxurious, but it gets great sunlight, making sitting there reminiscent of Southern Italy. With all I've said, you can tell we were very satisfied. I highly recommend it; don't miss the price of over 400 RMB.

name: Mamaka Bali
detail: It's right in front of the beach, and the beach walk is about a 5-minute walk. The rooftop bar and pool are very nice. However, as mentioned in the reviews, it seems like there is no soundproofing at all. There are sounds from machines and such. Fortunately, it's not loud until midnight. The problem is that there are a lot of impurities in the pool water.

name: Mercure Kuta Bali
detail: The last 10 days of this journey. I am extremely sensitive to noise. I was originally arranged to stay near a main road. Thank you to the lobby manager for assisting in changing to another room to avoid disturbances. The hotel is a bit old, but the service quality from the staff is very high. They always greet you with a smile whenever you meet. The room is spacious enough. The rooftop pool is excellent for watching the sunset. At night, if you're lucky, you can also see fireworks. The breakfast is also plentiful. The location is just across the road from Kota beach. There are many restaurants and convenience stores nearby. It's only a few minutes walk to Beachwalk shopping mall. If you don't want to eat fast food, this place is very suitable. It has world-famous brands and even a cinema. In 10 days, I watched 4 movies, each for only $2.5 USD. 🤣🤣🤣

name: YELLO Hotel Kuta Beachwalk Bali
detail: The beach is right in front, so it's within walking distance, and most importantly, there is a shopping center inside, making it easy to shop and browse for what we need. The room condition was decent and clean, and the breakfast was delicious.

name: Abian Harmony Resort Hotel and Spa
detail: The location is great, but the staff's service is exceptional as well. Starting from reception, everyone is kind and actively helps. Watching the staff help load our luggage into the Grab taxi while greeting us made me think that I would like to come back again. Our room was spacious and comfortable even for three people, making it really nice to relax. I could rest well and was almost reluctant to leave. The only downside was the bathroom lighting. The massages here are also good – I've tried other places too – I went twice during my two-night stay. The breakfast was diverse and delicious. It was a leisurely breakfast by the pool without any crowd.

name: White Penny Hostel
detail: I stayed for two nights in total, and the hostel is very clean. They clean the restrooms several times a day, and everything is spotless. The beds are very large; perhaps because it's off-season, there are fewer guests, but it's super quiet for sleeping, and my roommates are very well-mannered. The common area has a swimming pool, and there are eight showers for men and women, separated. The hostel offers a rich and varied breakfast, with staples and drinks, which is very delicious. What’s particularly noteworthy is that the staff are really friendly; they greet me whenever we meet, which is something our domestic hostels fall short on. Overall, this hostel has an extremely high cost-performance ratio, and its location is excellent, just a three-minute walk to the beach. I encourage more travelers to give it a try. Next time I come to Bali, I will definitely stay here again.

name: Prime Plaza Hotel Sanur - Bali
detail: Personally, this was the most surprising hotel of the trip. For Japanese people used to business hotels, it was very accommodating. - There is a water dispenser, so you can drink as much as you want (other hotels often provide two bottles a day). - The hotel corridor is not enclosed like in indoor hotels; it faces the outside like a regular apartment, so guests' voices echoing at night do not create noise. - The water pressure in the shower is great. Plenty of hot water is available. The shower has a door that properly seals off, preventing water from spilling outside and avoiding the common issue of wet bathrooms found in many hotels in Bali. - There is plenty of space to store luggage. Even with one extra-large suitcase and one medium suitcase, there is still room to spare. - The breakfast is average for a hotel priced around 10,000 for two people; it is neither exceptional nor bad. It is inferior compared to hotels around 15,000, but tolerable. It might be tough having breakfast for stays longer than three days. - There is a distance to the local night market and mall in Sanur, so it's better to use Grab (be careful as there are many fake Blue Bird taxis, which are individual scam taxis in Sanur!). - We went on a manta tour to Nusa Penida and Nusa Lembongan from Sanur Harbor, and it was very exhausting, so choosing this hotel was the right decision. By the way, from Sanur Harbor, you can easily walk along the coast heading south and just turn once to return to the hotel comfortably.
